mechanism: Phage and bacterial contigs differ in GC content (~41% vs ~55%); GC content alone or k-mer composition classifies them almost perfectly, so the accuracy says nothing about gene content. The sequences are random apart from GC: there are no genes to learn.
quantify: the model's 0.99 is no better than the composition baseline
fix: Report GC/k-mer baselines; evaluate on GC-matched phage and host contigs; test on phages from hosts with similar GC.
